title: Baku, Tbilisi & Yerevan Tour Package - 9 days
highlights: Explore Baku’s modern skyline, ancient Old City and eternal flames.
Visit Ateshgah Fire Temple and Yanardag Burning Mountain.
Discover Tbilisi and the ancient capital of Mtskheta.
Enjoy Georgian wine tasting and a cooking masterclass in Kakheti.
Discover Yerevan, Khor Virap, Noravank and Areni Winery.
Experience the history and traditions of three Caucasus capitals.
overview: Experience the Three Capitals Tour with Green Sky Travel, where the past meets the present in Baku, Tbilisi and Yerevan. This nine-day journey immerses you in the history, landscapes and traditions of Azerbaijan, Georgia and Armenia. From Ateshgah in Baku to Tbilisi’s cobblestone streets and the ancient monasteries around Yerevan, each destination tells its own story.

sections.title: Explore Baku, Tbilisi and Yerevan in Nine Days
paragraphs: Uncover the culture and history of three Caucasus capitals, from Baku’s modern skyline and ancient flames to Tbilisi’s vibrant streets and Yerevan’s monasteries.
Enjoy culinary experiences, historic landmarks and scenic beauty across Azerbaijan, Georgia and Armenia.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Baku and Transfer to the Hotel
description: Meet the Green Sky Travel team at the airport.
Transfer to the hotel and check in.
Enjoy free time to explore Baku and overnight in the city.

itinerary.title: Magical Journey through the Heart of Baku – Icheri Sheher and Gobustan
itinerary.description: Discover Baku’s historic Old City and explore the cultural heritage and landscapes of Gobustan.

itinerary.title: Absheron Peninsula – Yanardag Fire Mountain and Ateshgah Temple
itinerary.description: Visit the Absheron Peninsula, Mount Yanardag and the historic Ateshgah Fire Temple.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Baku Airport and Transfer to Tbilisi Hotel
itinerary.description: Transfer to Baku Airport, continue to Tbilisi and enjoy free time after hotel check-in.

itinerary.title: Kakheti, Bodbe, Sighnaghi, Wine Tasting and Cooking Masterclass
itinerary.description: Explore Kakheti, visit Bodbe and Sighnaghi, enjoy wine tasting and take part in a Georgian cooking masterclass.

itinerary.title: Exploring Kazbegi’s Majestic Landscapes
itinerary.description: Travel through the spectacular mountain scenery of Kazbegi and experience one of Georgia’s most beautiful regions.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Tbilisi Airport and Yerevan City Tour
itinerary.description: Transfer to Tbilisi Airport, continue to Yerevan and explore Republic Square, the Cascade Complex and the city’s lively streets.

itinerary.title: Yerevan, Khor Virap, Noravank and Areni Winery
itinerary.description: Explore Khor Virap Monastery, Noravank Monastery and Areni Winery.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to the airport for departure after exploring three Caucasus capitals.

excluded: Flights, meals except breakfast and visas
goodToKnow: Visa requirements vary by country; ensure you have the necessary travel documents.
Comfortable footwear is recommended for city exploration.
Local currency exchange options are available in all three capitals.
